title: The Wolf and the Lamb
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks past what is scary to find what comes next, and tonight Isaiah looks past today's troubles to a new earth where the wolf and the lamb eat side by side and nothing hurts.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because wondering what comes next is how a seeker walks. In Scout’s world today: The neighbor’s big dog barks and Scout’s feet freeze on the sidewalk. Scout crouches down slowly, holds out one careful hand, and waits. The dog leans in, and Scout’s whole face opens up. Just like the lamb who will one day rest beside the wolf, Scout learned that peace can grow where you thought it never could.
